rule:
Candidates: every non-merge commit by HELDOUT_AUTHOR reachable from HELDOUT_HEADS[repo], in both public repos.
two-file: the commit adds/modifies exactly 2 non-test .ts files and touches exactly 1 test .ts file (a test is *.test.ts or under a test/ directory), with no deleted non-test .ts file.
expression-edit: the M27 body miner (lib/minebody.ts mineBody, #136) records at least one EXPR_REPLACE observation for the commit.
Held out: every commit with either kind (kind 'two-file+expression-edit' when both).
Set: sha256('peaceai-heldout:v1:' + repo + '@' + sha), first byte even -> A (measured during development), odd -> B (untouched; final pass rate only).
Exclusion: both sets are excluded from every training corpus by path (same source) and by content sha256 (any source): every blob of a touched path at the commit, at its parent and at the pinned head.
